text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm prepping for Rice Shower's early<n>morning
training when I hear<n>someone arrive.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Big Brother... What<n>training are we
going to do today?
choice_data_list: You're up early. Did something good happen?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Big Sister... What<n>training are we
going to do today?
choice_data_list: You're up early. Did something good happen?
You're up early. Did something good happen?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Actually, I had a really great dream<n>last night!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I was training with you at night in a<n>beautiful field...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I was training with you at night in a<n>beautiful field...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But the stars were so pretty, we<n>stopped in the
middle of training to<n>gaze at them together...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It was such a relaxing dream, but<n>since I got my
rest there, I know I<n>have to work extra hard in
training<n>here!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Seems like Rice Shower got a good<n>rest.
